msg: Gnomes will provide points varying from 0-9 before any multipliers apply. There are two different groups of gnomes. One group provides higher points than the other group but the group that earns higher points changes gradually back and forth between the two groups as the rounds progress. For example gnomes from group 1 provide more points than gnomes from group 2 to begin with, and as the rounds progress gnomes from group 2 will provide more points than gnomes from group 1. The groups appear to be based on colour. The height of the gnomes will also change and the position they appear in (left or right of the screen). Group 1 is made up of the red, blue, pink and purple gnomes. Group 2 is made up of brown yellow green and orange gnomes.
